EX-99.1 2 pcvx-20261104xexx991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Vaxcyte Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update VAX-31 Adult Indication: Announced Positive Topline Data from OPUS-1 Pivotal Phase 3 Trial; VAX-31 Met All Prespecified Primary Endpoints, Was Well Tolerated and Demonstrated a Safety Profile Similar to PCV20 and PCV21 Across All Ages Studied VAX-31 Adult Indication: Company Expects to Report Results from OPUS-2 and OPUS-3 Phase 3 Trials in First Half of 2027, Supporting Planned Biologics License Application Submission in First Half of 2028 VAX-31 Infant Indication: Topline Safety, Tolerability and Immunogenicity Data from Primary Immunization Series and Booster Dose of Phase 2 Dose-Finding Study Expected Either Sequentially or Together by End of First Half of 2027 Phase 1 Study of VAX-A1, the Company's Vaccine Candidate Designed to Provide Broad Protection Against Disease Caused by Group A Streptococcus, Advancing to Stage 2 in Adults Pro Forma Cash, Cash Equivalents and Investments of Approximately $3.4 Billion as of September 30, 2026, Including Approximately $1.1 Billion in Net Proceeds from October 2026 Equity and Convertible Senior Notes Offerings SAN CARLOS, Calif., November 4, 2026 – Vaxcyte, Inc.

“The positive topline results from OPUS-1 represent a significant milestone for Vaxcyte and our broad-spectrum pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV) franchise,” said Grant Pickering, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder of Vaxcyte.

With OPUS-1 serving as the foundation of our planned Biologics License Application (BLA), we remain on track to announce results from the OPUS-2 and OPUS-3 Phase 3 trials in the first half of next year and, together with a manufacturing consistency study, we expect to submit a BLA in the first half of 2028.

For the VAX-31 infant indication, we expect to announce topline data from the primary immunization series and booster dose of the ongoing Phase 2 study, either sequentially or together, by the end of the first half of 2027.” “Following our positive OPUS-1 results, we completed concurrent equity and convertible senior notes offerings, raising approximately $1.1 billion in net proceeds, to further strengthen our balance sheet and extend our cash runway,” said Andrew Guggenhime, President and Chief Financial Officer of Vaxcyte.

“With approximately $3.4 billion in pro forma cash, cash equivalents and investments as of September 30, 2026, we are well positioned to support the potential U.S. commercial launch of VAX-31 for adults and advance our other key initiatives, including the VAX-31 OPUS-2 and OPUS-3 adult Phase 3 studies, the VAX-31 infant Phase 2 study, scale-up of our manufacturing and supply chain, and our earlier stage pipeline including VAX-A1 and VAX-XL.” Key Third Quarter and Recent Highlights PCV Franchise Adult Indication: Reported Positive Topline Data from OPUS-1, the Pivotal Adult Phase 3 Trial of VAX-31: In October 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from OPUS-1, which evaluated the safety, tolerability and immunogenicity of VAX-31, its next-generation 31-valent PCV candidate, for the prevention of invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) and pneumococcal pneumonia.
In addition, the Company is planning a manufacturing consistency study as the final Phase 3 study to enable the submission of the BLA.

VAX-31 Infant Indication • Announce topline safety, tolerability and immunogenicity data from the VAX-31 infant Phase 2 randomized, dose-finding study from both the primary three-dose immunization series and booster dose either sequentially or together by the end of the first half of 2027.
VAX-A1 • Announce topline data from the Phase 1 study in adults in the second half of 2027.
